stops.title: Welcome
stops.text: Three modules sit in a row: the loop, the ontology shell and three domain rings. Press Next, or hover anything for its source.
stops.look: Everything on screen is a toy layout; the numbers are real and carry their grade.

stops.title: The map: X3D Ontology 4.1
stops.text: 364 classes on a glass shell: longitude is the layout angle, latitude is the class's depth. Squares are abstract types, spheres are concrete nodes, colours are families.
stops.look: Hover a class: definition, family, how many parents the ontology predicts, and what the XSD said about them.
stops.src: data/explorer.json (364 classes, Web3D draft dated 29 September 2026)

stops.title: Born in 4.1
stops.text: 9 classes are new in 4.1, including EnvironmentLight, FontLibrary, GaussianSplats, HAnimPose, InlineGeometry. They pulse green.
stops.look: GaussianSplats is here: radiance fields became a first-class X3D node.

stops.title: Shape and its parents
stops.text: The ontology predicts 68 parent placements for Shape. For the 59 with a concrete parent the XSD accepts 22, rejects 30, and 7 are inconclusive.
stops.look: Arcs from Shape: green accepted, red rejected, amber inconclusive, blue abstract. The ontology is a map, not a gate.
stops.src: harness/xcheck_all.py (4.1 ontology vs XSD 4.1; same method as the doc's table, reproduced row by row)

stops.title: The loop
stops.text: A packet circles seven stations. It turns red at x3d_mcp, a report packet flies back to the agent, a repair turns it green, and the tether stamps the result.
stops.look: Watch the colour: white spec, blue draft, red invalid, amber report, green repaired, gold stamp.

stops.title: x3d_mcp, the exact oracle
stops.text: Whole-scene validation of this 166 KB demo: 1.8 s. A median tool call: 1.9 ms. In the doc's E1 run, first-try validity went 27.3% to 56.7% with two retrieved examples, and about 100% after report-guided repair.
stops.look: Checks are cheap, deterministic and line-located: that is what makes a loop possible.

stops.title: Domain ring: X3D's components
stops.text: 37 components, each its own field. The XSD accepts 73.3% of the ontology's predictions for Sound but only 10.9% for Layering and 25.3% for RigidBodyPhysics.
stops.look: Bead colour is the accepted share. The more specialist the vocabulary, the less the supertype ranges say (my reading, L).

stops.title: URDF and glTF rings
stops.text: URDF: 24 fault kinds, 135 mutants (my own rules, L). glTF: 25 kinds, 123 mutants; the Khronos validator flags 106 (86.2%) at error level, and 17 of the 123 mutants (from three fault kinds) only as warnings.
stops.look: Hover a bead for the fault. Orange and amber beads are the ones a gate that counts only errors would let through.

stops.title: Model results
stops.text: Pillars: first try in blue, after the report loop in green, for each domain. X3D 77% to 100%, URDF 95% to 100%, glTF 40% to 82% (Gemini flash, n=60 first tries each).
stops.look: The same loop, three domains, one model.

stops.title: Assemble
stops.text: The loop and the rings are drawn into the shell. Captions fade, the star flares, a shockwave rolls out.
stops.look: One sphere: the ontology proposes, shapes dispose, the validator gates.

stops.title: What is not here
stops.text: No Shroud content and no simulated sc: layer. Layout, colours and motion are display choices. Everything is private until 2027-01-01.
stops.look: Use the buttons to replay the film, jump to a stop, or roam freely.

AcousticProperties.defn: AcousticProperties specifies the interaction of sound waves with characteristics of geometric objects in the scene.

Analyser.defn: Analyser provides real-time frequency and time-domain analysis information, without any signal-processing change to the audio stream which is passed unprocessed from input to output.

Anchor.defn: Anchor is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

Appearance.defn: Appearance specifies the visual properties of geometry by containing the Material, ImageTexture/MovieTexture/PixelTexture, FillProperties, LineProperties, programmable shader nodes (ComposedShader, Pa

Arc2D.defn: Arc2D is a line-based geometry node that defines a linear circular arc with center (0,0) in X-Y plane, with angles measured starting at positive x-axis and sweeping towards positive y-axis.

ArcClose2D.defn: ArcClose2D is a polygonal geometry node that defines a linear circular arc, closed by PIE or CHORD line segments, with center (0,0) in X-Y plane, with angles measured starting at positive x-axis and s

AudioClip.defn: AudioClip provides audio data used by parent Sound nodes.

AudioDestination.defn: AudioDestination node represents the final audio destination and is what user ultimately hears, typically from the speakers of user device.

Background.defn: Background simulates ground and sky, using vertical arrays of wraparound color values.

BallJoint.defn: BallJoint represents an unconstrained joint between two bodies that pivot about a common anchor point.

Billboard.defn: Billboard is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

BiquadFilter.defn: BiquadFilter node is an AudioNode processor implementing common low-order filters.

BlendedVolumeStyle.defn: BlendedVolumeStyle combines rendering of two voxel data sets into one by blending voxel values.

BooleanFilter.defn: BooleanFilter selectively passes true, false or negated events.

BooleanSequencer.defn: BooleanSequencer generates periodic discrete Boolean values.

BooleanToggle.defn: BooleanToggle maintains state and negates output when a true input is provided.

BooleanTrigger.defn: BooleanTrigger converts time events to boolean true events.

BoundaryEnhancementVolumeStyle.defn: BoundaryEnhancementVolumeStyle provides boundary enhancement for the volume rendering style.

BoundedPhysicsModel.defn: BoundedPhysicsModel provides user-defined geometrical boundaries for particle motion.

Box.defn: Box is a geometry node specifying a rectangular cuboid.

BufferAudioSource.defn: BufferAudioSource node represents a memory-resident audio asset that can contain one or more channels.

CADAssembly.defn: CADAssembly holds a set of Computer-Aided Design (CAD) assemblies or parts grouped together.

CADFace.defn: CADFace holds geometry representing one face in a Computer-Aided Design (CAD) CADPart.

CADLayer.defn: CADLayer nodes define a hierarchy that shows layer structure for a Computer-Aided Design (CAD) model.

CADPart.defn: CADPart is an atomic part that defines both coordinate-system location and the faces that constitute a part in a Computer-Aided Design (CAD) model.

CartoonVolumeStyle.defn: CartoonVolumeStyle generates cartoon-style non-photorealistic rendering of associated volumetric data.

ChannelMerger.defn: ChannelMerger unites different input channels into a single output channel.

ChannelSelector.defn: ChannelSelector selects a single channel output from all input channels.

ChannelSplitter.defn: ChannelSplitter separates the different channels of a single audio source into a set of monophonic output channels.

Circle2D.defn: Circle2D is a geometry node that defines a linear X-Y circle with center (0,0) in X-Y plane.

ClipPlane.defn: ClipPlane specifies a single plane equation used to clip (i.

CollidableOffset.defn: CollidableOffset repositions geometry relative to center of owning body.

CollidableShape.defn: CollidableShape connects the collision detection system, the rigid body model, and the renderable scene graph.

Collision.defn: Collision detects camera-to-object contact using current view and NavigationInfo avatarSize.

CollisionCollection.defn: CollisionCollection holds a collection of objects that can be managed as a single entity for resolution of inter-object collisions.

CollisionSpace.defn: CollisionSpace holds collection of objects considered together for resolution of inter-object collisions.

Color.defn: Color node defines a set of RGB color values that apply either to a sibling Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, or else to a parent ElevationGrid node.

ColorChaser.defn: ColorChaser generates a series of SFColor values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

ColorDamper.defn: ColorDamper generates a series of RGB color values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

ColorInterpolator.defn: ColorInterpolator generates a range of color values.

ColorRGBA.defn: ColorRGBA node defines a set of RGBA color values that apply either to a sibling Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, or else to a parent ElevationGrid node.

ComposedCubeMapTexture.defn: ComposedCubeMapTexture is a texture node that defines a cubic environment map source as an explicit set of images drawn from individual 2D texture nodes.

ComposedShader.defn: ComposedShader can contain field declarations, but no CDATA section of plain-text source code, since programs are composed from child ShaderPart nodes.

ComposedTexture3D.defn: ComposedTexture3D defines a 3D image-based texture map as a collection of 2D texture sources at various depths.

ComposedVolumeStyle.defn: ComposedVolumeStyle allows compositing multiple rendering styles into single rendering pass.

ConeEmitter.defn: ConeEmitter generates all available particles from a specific point in space.

Contact.defn: Contact nodes are produced as output events when two collidable objects or spaces make contact.

Contour2D.defn: Contour2D groups a set of curve segments into a composite contour.

ContourPolyline2D.defn: ContourPolyline2D defines a linear curve segment as part of a trimming contour in the u-v domain of a NURBS surface.

Convolver.defn: Convolver performs a linear convolution on a given AudioBuffer, often used to achieve a reverberation effect.

Coordinate.defn: Coordinate builds geometry by defining a set of 3D coordinate (triplet) point values.

CoordinateChaser.defn: CoordinateChaser generates a series of coordinate arrays that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

CoordinateDamper.defn: CoordinateDamper generates a series of coordinate arrays that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

CoordinateDouble.defn: CoordinateDouble builds geometry by defining a set of 3D coordinate (triplet) point values.

CoordinateInterpolator.defn: CoordinateInterpolator linearly interpolates among a list of 3-tuple MFVec3f arrays, producing a single MFVec3f array that is fractional average between two nearest arrays in the list.

CoordinateInterpolator2D.defn: CoordinateInterpolator2D generates a series of SFVec2f or MFVec2f 2-tuple float values.

CylinderSensor.defn: CylinderSensor converts pointer motion (for example, a mouse or wand) into rotation values using an invisible cylinder aligned with local Y-axis.

DISEntityManager.defn: DISEntityManager notifies a scene when new DIS ESPDU entities arrive or current entities leave.

DISEntityTypeMapping.defn: DISEntityTypeMapping provides a best-match mapping from DIS ESPDU entity type information to a specific X3D model, thus providing a visual and behavioral representation that best matches the entity ty

Delay.defn: Delay causes a time delay between the arrival of input data and subsequent propagation to the output.

DirectionalLight.defn: DirectionalLight might not be scoped by parent Group or Transform at levels 1 or 2.

Disk2D.defn: Disk2D is a geometry node that defines a filled (or partially filled) planar circle with center (0,0).

DoubleAxisHingeJoint.defn: DoubleAxisHingeJoint has two independent axes located around a common anchor point.

DynamicsCompressor.defn: DynamicsCompressor node implements a dynamics compression effect, lowering volume of loudest parts of signal and raising volume of softest parts.

EXPORT.defn: Functional summary: EXPORT exposes a local node for ROUTE passing of event values when the current Scene is included via Inline by a parent external world. These connections allow event values to be e

EaseInEaseOut.defn: EaseInEaseOut enables gradual animation transitions by modifying TimeSensor fraction outputs.

EdgeEnhancementVolumeStyle.defn: EdgeEnhancementVolumeStyle specifies edge enhancement for the volume rendering style.

ElevationGrid.defn: ElevationGrid is a geometry node defining a rectangular height field, with default values for a 1m by 1m square at height 0.

EnvironmentLight.defn: EnvironmentLight node uses an environment map to represent incident illumination around a point, and can be used to show reflections of distant objects.

EspduTransform.defn: EspduTransform is a networked Transform node that can contain most nodes.

ExplosionEmitter.defn: ExplosionEmitter generates all particles from a specific point in space at the initial time enabled.

ExternProtoDeclare.defn: ExternProtoDeclare refers to a ProtoDeclare node declaration provided in another file. ExternProtoDeclare interfaces are defined by field statements (and without IS/connect statements).

Extrusion.defn: Extrusion is a geometry node that sequentially stretches a 2D cross section along a 3D-spine path in the local coordinate system, creating an outer hull.

FillProperties.defn: FillProperties indicates whether appearance is filled or hatched for associated geometry inside the same Shape.

FloatVertexAttribute.defn: FloatVertexAttribute defines a set of per-vertex single-precision floating-point attributes.

Fog.defn: Fog simulates atmospheric effects by blending distant objects with fog color.

FogCoordinate.defn: FogCoordinate defines a set of explicit fog depths on a per-vertex basis, overriding Fog visibilityRange.

FontLibrary.defn: FontLibrary can load additional fonts for use by Text and FontStyle nodes.

FontStyle.defn: FontStyle is an X3DFontStyleNode that defines the size, family, justification, and other styles used by Text nodes.

ForcePhysicsModel.defn: ForcePhysicsModel applies a constant force value to the particles.

Gain.defn: The Gain node amplifies or deamplifies the input signal.

GaussianSplats.defn: The GaussianSplats node adds basic support for direct real-time radiance field rendering of volume data without converting into surface or line primitives.

GeneratedCubeMapTexture.defn: GeneratedCubeMapTexture is a texture node that defines a cubic environment map that sources its data from internally generated images.

GeoCoordinate.defn: GeoCoordinate builds geometry as a set of geographic 3D coordinates.

GeoElevationGrid.defn: GeoElevationGrid is a geometry node defining a rectangular height field, with default values for a 1m by 1m square at height 0.

GeoLOD.defn: Note that MFNode rootNode field can contain multiple nodes and has accessType inputOutput. Meanwhile MFNode children field is outputOnly, unlike other X3DGroupingNode exemplars.

GeoLocation.defn: GeoLocation positions a regular X3D model onto the earth's surface.

GeoMetadata.defn: GeoMetadata includes a generic subset of metadata about the geographic data.

GeoOrigin.defn: GeoOrigin is deprecated and discouraged (but nevertheless allowed) in X3D version 3.3. GeoOrigin is restored in X3D version 4.0 for special use on devices with limited floating-point resolution.

GeoPositionInterpolator.defn: GeoPositionInterpolator animates objects within a geographic coordinate system.

GeoProximitySensor.defn: GeoProximitySensor generates events when the viewer enters, exits and moves within a region of space (defined by a box).

GeoTouchSensor.defn: GeoTouchSensor returns geographic coordinates for the object being selected.

GeoTransform.defn: GeoTransform is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

GeoViewpoint.defn: GeoViewpoint specifies viewpoints using geographic coordinates.

Group.defn: Group is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

HAnimDisplacer.defn: HAnimDisplacer nodes alter the shape of coordinate-based geometry within parent HAnimSegment or ancestor HAnimHumanoid nodes.

HAnimHumanoid.defn: The HAnimHumanoid node is used to: (a) store references to the joints, segments, sites, skeleton, optional skin, and fixed viewpoints, (b) serve as a container for the entire humanoid, (c) provide a c

HAnimJoint.defn: HAnimJoint node can represent each joint in a body.

HAnimMotion.defn: An HAnimMotion node supports discrete frame-by-frame playback for HAnim motion data animation.

HAnimPose.defn: HAnimPose nodes support setting HAnimJoint values in a corresponding HAnimHumanoid skeleton.

HAnimSegment.defn: HAnimSegment node contains Shape geometry for each body segment, providing a visual representation of the skeleton segment.

HAnimSite.defn: An HAnimSite node serves three purposes: (a) define an end effector location which can be used by an inverse kinematics system, (b) define an attachment point for accessories such as jewelry and cloth

IMPORT.defn: Functional summary: IMPORT provides ROUTE access to a node that has a corresponding EXPORT statement within an Inline scene. These connections allow event values to be exchanged via ROUTE statements b

IS.defn: Functional summary: the IS statement connects node fields defined inside a ProtoBody declaration back to corresponding ProtoInterface fields. IS/connect statements can be added if the parent node is w

ImageCubeMapTexture.defn: ImageCubeMapTexture is a texture node that defines a cubic environment map source as a single file format that contains multiple images, one for each side.

ImageTexture.defn: ImageTexture maps a 2D-image file onto a geometric shape.

ImageTexture3D.defn: ImageTexture3D defines a 3D image-based texture map by specifying a single image file that contains complete 3D data.

IndexedFaceSet.defn: IndexedFaceSet defines polygons using index lists corresponding to vertex coordinates.

IndexedLineSet.defn: IndexedLineSet defines polyline segments using index lists corresponding to vertex coordinates.

IndexedQuadSet.defn: IndexedQuadSet is a geometry node that defines quadrilaterals.

IndexedTriangleFanSet.defn: IndexedTriangleFanSet is a geometry node containing a Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, and can also contain Color|ColorRGBA, Normal and TextureCoordinate nodes.

IndexedTriangleSet.defn: IndexedTriangleSet is a geometry node containing a Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, and can also contain Color|ColorRGBA, Normal and TextureCoordinate nodes.

IndexedTriangleStripSet.defn: IndexedTriangleStripSet is a geometry node containing a Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, and can also contain Color|ColorRGBA, Normal and TextureCoordinate nodes.

Inline.defn: Inline can load another X3D or VRML model into the current scene via url.

InlineGeometry.defn: InlineGeometry loads geometry from an external file.

IntegerSequencer.defn: IntegerSequencer generates periodic discrete integer values.

IntegerTrigger.defn: IntegerTrigger converts set_boolean true input events to an integer value (for example, useful when animating whichChoice in a Switch node).

IsoSurfaceVolumeData.defn: IsoSurfaceVolumeData displays one or more surfaces extracted from a voxel dataset.

KeySensor.defn: KeySensor generates events as the user presses keys on the keyboard.

LOD.defn: LOD (Level Of Detail) uses camera-to-object distance to switch among contained child levels.

Layer.defn: Layer contains a list of children nodes that define the contents of the layer.

LayerSet.defn: LayerSet defines a list of layers and a rendering order.

Layout.defn: Layout node is used as layout field of LayoutLayer and LayoutGroup nodes.

LayoutGroup.defn: LayoutGroup is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes, whose children are related by a common layout within a parent layout.

LayoutLayer.defn: LayoutLayer is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

LinePickSensor.defn: LinePickSensor uses one or more pickingGeometry line segments to compute intersections with pickTarget shapes.

LineProperties.defn: LineProperties allows precise fine-grained control over the rendering style of lines and edges for associated geometry inside the same Shape.

LineSet.defn: LineSet is a geometry node that can contain a Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node and optionally a Color|ColorRGBA node.

ListenerPointSource.defn: ListenerPointSource node represents position and orientation of a person listening to virtual sound in the audio scene, and provides single or multiple sound channels as output.

LoadSensor.defn: LoadSensor generates events as children (watchList in X3Dv3) child nodes are either loaded or fail to load.

LocalFog.defn: LocalFog simulates atmospheric effects by blending distant objects with fog color.

Material.defn: Material specifies surface rendering properties for associated geometry.

Matrix3VertexAttribute.defn: Matrix3VertexAttribute defines a set of per-vertex 3x3 matrix attributes.

Matrix4VertexAttribute.defn: Matrix4VertexAttribute defines a set of per-vertex 4x4 matrix attributes.

MetadataBoolean.defn: The metadata provided by this node is contained in the Boolean values of the value field.

MetadataDouble.defn: The metadata provided by this node is contained in the double-precision floating point numbers of the value field.

MetadataFloat.defn: The metadata provided by this node is contained in the single-precision floating point numbers of the value field.

MetadataInteger.defn: The metadata provided by this node is contained in the integer numbers of the value field.

MetadataSet.defn: The metadata provided by this node is contained in the metadata nodes of the value field.

MetadataString.defn: The metadata provided by this node is contained in the strings of the value field.

MicrophoneSource.defn: MicrophoneSource captures input from a physical microphone in the real world.

MotorJoint.defn: MotorJoint drives relative angular velocities between body1 and body2 within a common reference frame.

MovieTexture.defn: MovieTexture applies a 2D movie image to surface geometry, or provides audio for a Sound node.

MultiTexture.defn: MultiTexture applies several individual textures to a single geometry node, enabling a variety of visual effects that include light mapping and environment mapping.

MultiTextureCoordinate.defn: MultiTextureCoordinate contains multiple TextureCoordinate or TextureCoordinateGenerator nodes, for use by a parent polygonal geometry node such as IndexedFaceSet or a Triangle* node.

MultiTextureTransform.defn: MultiTextureTransform contains multiple TextureTransform nodes, each provided for use by corresponding ImageTexture MovieTexture or PixelTexture nodes within a sibling MultiTexture node.

NavigationInfo.defn: NavigationInfo describes the user's viewing model, user navigation-interaction modalities, and also dimensional characteristics of the user's (typically invisible) avatar.

Normal.defn: Normal defines a set of 3D surface-normal vectors that apply either to a sibling Coordinate | CoordinateDouble node, or else to a parent ElevationGrid node.

NormalInterpolator.defn: NormalInterpolator generates a series of normal (perpendicular) 3-tuple SFVec3f values.

NurbsCurve.defn: NurbsCurve is a 3D curve analogous to NurbsPatchSurface.

NurbsCurve2D.defn: NurbsCurve2D defines a trimming segment that is part of a trimming contour in the u-v domain of a surface.

NurbsOrientationInterpolator.defn: NurbsOrientationInterpolator describes a 3D NURBS curve and outputs interpolated orientation values.

NurbsPatchSurface.defn: NurbsPatchSurface defines a contiguous 3D Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS) surface.

NurbsPositionInterpolator.defn: NurbsPositionInterpolator describes a 3D NURBS curve and outputs interpolated position values.

NurbsSet.defn: NurbsSet collects a set of NurbsSurface nodes into a common group and treats NurbsSurface set as a unit during tessellation, thereby enforcing tessellation continuity along borders.

NurbsSurfaceInterpolator.defn: NurbsSurfaceInterpolator describes a 3D NURBS curve and outputs interpolated position and normal values.

NurbsSweptSurface.defn: NurbsSweptSurface uses a trajectoryCurve path to describe a generalized surface that is swept by a crossSectionCurve.

NurbsSwungSurface.defn: NurbsSwungSurface contains a profileCurve and a trajectoryCurve [X3DNurbsControlCurveNode].

NurbsTextureCoordinate.defn: NurbsTextureCoordinate describes a 3D NURBS surface in the parametric domain of its surface host, specifying mapping of texture onto the surface.

NurbsTrimmedSurface.defn: NurbsTrimmedSurface generates texture coordinates from a Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS) surface.

OpacityMapVolumeStyle.defn: OpacityMapVolumeStyle specifies that volumetric data is rendered using opacity mapped to a transfer function texture.

OrientationChaser.defn: OrientationChaser generates a series of 4-tuple axis-angle SFRotation values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

OrientationDamper.defn: OrientationDamper generates a series of 4-tuple axis-angle SFRotation values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

OrientationInterpolator.defn: OrientationInterpolator generates a series of 4-tuple axis-angle SFRotation values.

OrthoViewpoint.defn: OrthoViewpoint provides an orthographic perspective-free view of a scene from a specific location and direction.

OscillatorSource.defn: OscillatorSource node represents an audio source generating a periodic waveform, providing a constant tone.

PackagedShader.defn: PackagedShader can contain field declarations, but no CDATA section of plain-text source code.

ParticleSystem.defn: ParticleSystem specifies a complete particle system.

PeriodicWave.defn: PeriodicWave defines a periodic waveform that can be used to shape the output of an Oscillator.

PhysicalMaterial.defn: PhysicalMaterial specifies Physically Based Rendering (PBR) properties for associated geometry.

PickableGroup.defn: PickableGroup is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

PixelTexture.defn: PixelTexture creates a 2D-image texture map using a numeric array of pixel values.

PixelTexture3D.defn: PixelTexture3D defines a 3D image-based texture map as an explicit array of pixel values (image field).

PlaneSensor.defn: PlaneSensor converts pointing device motion into 2D translation parallel to the local Z=0 plane.

PointEmitter.defn: PointEmitter generates particles from a specific point in space using the specified direction and speed.

PointLight.defn: Linear attenuation may occur at level 2, full support at level 3.

PointPickSensor.defn: PointPickSensor tests one or more pickingGeometry points in space as lying inside the provided pickTarget geometry.

PointProperties.defn: PointProperties allows precise fine-grained control over the rendering style of PointSet node points inside the same Shape.

PointSet.defn: PointSet is a node that contains a set of colored 3D points, represented by contained Color|ColorRGBA and Coordinate|CoordinateDouble nodes.

Polyline2D.defn: Polyline2D is a geometry node that defines a connected set of vertices in a contiguous set of line segments in X-Y plane.

PolylineEmitter.defn: PolylineEmitter emits particles along a single polyline.

Polypoint2D.defn: Polypoint2D is a geometry node that defines a set of 2D points in X-Y plane.

PositionChaser.defn: PositionChaser generates a series of position values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

PositionChaser2D.defn: PositionChaser2D generates a series of 2D position values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

PositionDamper.defn: PositionDamper generates a series of position values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

PositionDamper2D.defn: PositionDamper2D generates a series of 2D floating-point values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

PositionInterpolator.defn: PositionInterpolator generates a series of 3-tuple SFVec3f values.

PositionInterpolator2D.defn: PositionInterpolator2D generates a series of SFVec2f values.

PrimitivePickSensor.defn: If a non-uniform scale is applied to the pick sensor, correct results may require level 3 support.

ProgramShader.defn: ProgramShader contains no field declarations and no plain-text source code.

ProjectionVolumeStyle.defn: ProjectionVolumeStyle uses voxel data to directly generate output color.

ProtoBody.defn: ProtoBody contains the definition nodes for new Prototype nodes.

ProtoDeclare.defn: ProtoDeclare defines new Prototype nodes. Nested ProtoDeclares and ProtoInstances are allowed by the X3D Architecture specification.

ProtoInstance.defn: ProtoInstance can override field default values via fieldValue initializations. Non-recursive nested ProtoInstance and ProtoDeclare statements are allowed within a ProtoDeclare.

ProtoInterface.defn: ProtoInterface defines fields for new Prototype nodes.

ProximitySensor.defn: ProximitySensor generates events when the viewer enters, exits and moves within a region of space (defined by a box).

QuadSet.defn: QuadSet is a geometry node that defines quadrilaterals.

ROUTE.defn: ROUTE connects output fields of event-producing nodes to input fields of event-consuming nodes.

ReceiverPdu.defn: ReceiverPdu is a networked Protocol Data Unit (PDU) information node that transmits the state of radio frequency (RF) receivers modeled in a simulation.

Rectangle2D.defn: Rectangle2D is a geometry node that defines a 2D rectangle in X-Y plane.

RenderedTexture.defn: RenderedTexture is a texture node that renders the view from a local viewpoint or separate scene into an offscreen buffer, producing an image or depth map that can be rendered from model geometry in r

RigidBody.defn: RigidBody describes a collection of shapes with a mass distribution that is affected by the physics model.

RigidBodyCollection.defn: RigidBodyCollection represents a system of bodies that interact within a single physics model.

ScalarChaser.defn: ScalarChaser generates a series of single floating-point values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

ScalarDamper.defn: ScalarDamper generates a series of floating-point values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

Scene.defn: Scene is the implicit root node of the X3D scene graph.

ScreenFontStyle.defn: ScreenFontStyle is an X3DFontStyleNode defines the size, family, justification, and other styles used within a screen layout.

ScreenGroup.defn: ScreenGroup is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

Script.defn: Script contains author-programmed event behaviors for a scene.

SegmentedVolumeData.defn: SegmentedVolumeData displays a segmented voxel dataset with different RenderStyle nodes.

ShadedVolumeStyle.defn: All fields fully supported except shadows supported with at least Phong shading at level 3. All fields fully supported with at least Phong shading and Henyey-Greenstein phase function, shadows fully s

ShaderPart.defn: ShaderPart can contain a CDATA section of plain-text source code.

ShaderProgram.defn: ShaderProgram can contain field declarations and a CDATA section of plain-text source code.

Shape.defn: Shape can appear under any grouping node.

SignalPdu.defn: SignalPdu is a networked Protocol Data Unit (PDU) information node that communicates the transmission of voice, audio or other data modeled in a simulation.

SilhouetteEnhancementVolumeStyle.defn: SilhouetteEnhancementVolumeStyle specifies that volumetric data is rendered with silhouette enhancement.

SingleAxisHingeJoint.defn: SingleAxisHingeJoint has single axis about which to rotate, similar to a traditional door hinge. Contains two RigidBody nodes (containerField values body1, body2).

SliderJoint.defn: SliderJoint constrains all movement between body1 and body2 along a single axis. Contains two RigidBody nodes (containerField values body1, body2).

Sound.defn: The Sound node controls the 3D spatialization of sound playback by a child AudioClip or MovieTexture node.

SpatialSound.defn: The SpatialSound node controls the 3D spatialization of sound playback by a child AudioClip or MovieTexture node.

Sphere.defn: Sphere is a geometry node, representing a perfectly round geometrical object that is the surface of a completely round ball.

SphereSensor.defn: SphereSensor converts pointing device motion into a spherical rotation about the origin of the local coordinate system.

SplinePositionInterpolator.defn: SplinePositionInterpolator performs non-linear interpolation among paired lists of 3-tuple values and velocities to produce an SFVec3f value_changed output event.

SplinePositionInterpolator2D.defn: SplinePositionInterpolator2D performs non-linear interpolation among paired lists of 2-tuple values and velocities to produce an SFVec2f value_changed output event.

SplineScalarInterpolator.defn: SplineScalarInterpolator performs non-linear interpolation among paired lists of float values and velocities to produce an SFFloat value_changed output event.

SpotLight.defn: Linear attenuation may occur at level 2, full support at level 3.

SquadOrientationInterpolator.defn: SquadOrientationInterpolator performs non-linear interpolation among paired lists of rotation values to produce an SFRotation value_changed output event.

StaticGroup.defn: StaticGroup is similar to Group node but does not allow access to children after creation time.

StreamAudioDestination.defn: StreamAudioDestination node represents the final audio destination via a media stream.

StreamAudioSource.defn: StreamAudioSource operates as an audio source whose media is received from a MediaStream obtained using the WebRTC or Media Capture and Streams APIs.

StringSensor.defn: StringSensor generates events as the user enters strings on the keyboard.

SurfaceEmitter.defn: SurfaceEmitter generates particles from the surface of an object.

Switch.defn: Switch is a Grouping node that only renders one (or zero) child at a time.

Tangent.defn: Tangent defines a set of 3D surface-normal vectors that apply either to a sibling Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, or else to a parent ElevationGrid node.

TexCoordChaser2D.defn: TexCoordChaser2D generates a series of single floating-point values that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

TexCoordDamper2D.defn: TexCoordDamper2D generates a series of 2D floating-point arrays that progressively change from initial value to destination value.

Text.defn: Text is a 2D (flat) geometry node that can contain multiple lines of string values.

TextureBackground.defn: TextureBackground simulates ground and sky, using vertical arrays of wraparound color values, TextureBackground can also provide backdrop texture images on all six sides.

TextureCoordinate.defn: TextureCoordinate specifies 2D (s,t) texture-coordinate points, used by vertex-based geometry nodes (such as IndexedFaceSet or ElevationGrid) to map textures to vertices (and patches to NURBS surfaces

TextureCoordinate3D.defn: TextureCoordinate3D specifies a set of 3D texture coordinates used by vertex-based geometry nodes (such as IndexedFaceSet or ElevationGrid) to map 3D textures to vertices.

TextureCoordinate4D.defn: TextureCoordinate4D specifies a set of 4D (homogeneous 3D) texture coordinates used by vertex-based geometry nodes (such as IndexedFaceSet or ElevationGrid) to map 3D textures to vertices.

TextureCoordinateGenerator.defn: TextureCoordinateGenerator computes 2D (s,t) texture-coordinate points, used by vertex-based geometry nodes (such as IndexedFaceSet or ElevationGrid) to map textures to vertices (and patches to NURBS

TextureProjector.defn: TextureProjector is similar to a light that projects a texture into the scene, illuminating geometry that intersects the perspective projection volume.

TextureProjectorParallel.defn: TextureProjectorParallel is similar to a light that projects a texture into the scene, illuminating geometry that intersects the parallel projection volume.

TextureProperties.defn: TextureProperties allows precise fine-grained control over application of image textures to geometry.

TextureTransform.defn: TextureTransform shifts 2D texture coordinates for positioning, orienting and scaling image textures on geometry.

TextureTransform3D.defn: TextureTransform3D applies a 3D transformation to texture coordinates.

TextureTransformMatrix3D.defn: TextureTransformMatrix3D applies a 3D transformation to texture coordinates.

TimeSensor.defn: TimeSensor continuously generates events as time passes.

TimeTrigger.defn: TimeTrigger converts boolean true events to time events.

ToneMappedVolumeStyle.defn: ToneMappedVolumeStyle specifies that volumetric data is rendered with Gooch shading model of two-toned warm/cool coloring.

TouchSensor.defn: TouchSensor tracks location and state of the pointing device, detecting when a user points at or selects (activates) geometry.

Transform.defn: Transform is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

TransformSensor.defn: TransformSensor generates output events when its targetObject enters, exits, and moves within a region in space (defined by a box).

TransmitterPdu.defn: TransmitterPdu is a networked Protocol Data Unit (PDU) information node that provides detailed information about a radio transmitter modeled in a simulation.

TriangleFanSet.defn: TriangleFanSet is a geometry node containing a Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, and can also contain Color|ColorRGBA, Normal and TextureCoordinate nodes.

TriangleSet.defn: TriangleSet is a geometry node containing a Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, and can also contain Color|ColorRGBA, Normal and TextureCoordinate nodes.

TriangleSet2D.defn: TriangleSet2D is a geometry node that defines a set of filled 2D triangles in X-Y plane.

TriangleStripSet.defn: TriangleStripSet is a geometry node containing a Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, and can also contain Color|ColorRGBA, Normal and TextureCoordinate nodes.

TwoSidedMaterial.defn: TwoSidedMaterial specifies surface rendering properties for associated geometry, for outer (front) and inner (back) sides of polygons.

UniversalJoint.defn: UniversalJoint is like a BallJoint that constrains an extra degree of rotational freedom.

UnlitMaterial.defn: UnlitMaterial specifies surface rendering properties for associated geometry that is unaffected by scene lighting.

Viewpoint.defn: Viewpoint provides a specific location and direction where the user may view the scene.

ViewpointGroup.defn: ViewpointGroup can contain Viewpoint, OrthoViewpoint, GeoViewpoint and other ViewpointGroup nodes for better user-navigation support with a shared description on the viewpoint list.

Viewport.defn: Viewport is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

VisibilitySensor.defn: VisibilitySensor detects when user can see a specific object or region as they navigate the world.

VolumeData.defn: VolumeData displays a simple non-segmented voxel dataset with a single RenderStyle node.

VolumeEmitter.defn: VolumeEmitter emits particles from a random position confined within the given closed geometry volume.

VolumePickSensor.defn: VolumePickSensor tests picking intersections using the pickingGeometry against the pickTarget geometry volume.

WaveShaper.defn: WaveShaper node represents a nonlinear distorter that applies a wave-shaping distortion curve to the signal.

WindPhysicsModel.defn: WindPhysicsModel applies a wind effect to the particles.

WorldInfo.defn: WorldInfo contains a title and simple persistent metadata information about an X3D scene. This node is strictly for documentation purposes and has no effect on the visual appearance or behaviour of th

X3D.defn: X3D is the root node for an Extensible 3D (X3D) Graphics model.

X3DAppearanceChildNode.defn: Nodes of this type can be used as child nodes for Appearance.

X3DAppearanceNode.defn: Base type for all Appearance nodes.

X3DArrayField.defn: X3DArrayField is the abstract field type from which all field types that can contain multiple values are derived, implementing the X3DField interface. All fields derived from X3DArrayField have names

X3DBackgroundNode.defn: Abstract type from which all backgrounds inherit, also defining a background binding stack.

X3DBindableNode.defn: Bindable nodes implement the binding stack, so that only one of each node type is active at a given time.

X3DBoundedObject.defn: X3DBoundedObject indicates that bounding box values can be provided (or computed) to encompass this node and any children.

X3DChaserNode.defn: The X3DChaserNode abstract node type calculates the output on value_changed as a finite impulse response (FIR) based on the events received on set_destination field.

X3DChildNode.defn: A node that implements X3DChildNode is one of the legal children for a X3DGroupingNode parent.

X3DColorNode.defn: Base type for color specifications in X3D.

X3DComposableVolumeRenderStyleNode.defn: The X3DComposableVolumeRenderStyleNode abstract node type is the base type for all node types that allow rendering styles to be sequentially composed together to form a single renderable output.

X3DComposedGeometryNode.defn: Composed geometry nodes produce renderable geometry, can contain Color Coordinate Normal TextureCoordinate, and are contained by a Shape node.

X3DCoordinateNode.defn: Base type for all coordinate node types in X3D.

X3DDamperNode.defn: The X3DDamperNode abstract node type creates an IIR response that approaches the destination value according to the shape of the e-function only asymptotically but very quickly.

X3DDragSensorNode.defn: Base type for all drag-style pointing device sensors.

X3DEnvironmentTextureNode.defn: Base type for all nodes that specify cubic environment map sources for texture images.

X3DEnvironmentalSensorNode.defn: Base type for the environmental sensor nodes ProximitySensor, TransformSensor and VisibilitySensor.

X3DField.defn: X3DField is the abstract field type from which all single values field types are derived. All fields directly derived from X3DField have names beginning with SF (single-valued field). SF fields may on

X3DFogObject.defn: Abstract type describing a node that influences the lighting equation through the use of fog semantics.

X3DFollowerNode.defn: X3DFollowerNode is the abstract base class for all nodes in the Followers component.

X3DFontStyleNode.defn: Base type for all font style nodes.

X3DGeometricPropertyNode.defn: Base type for all geometric property node types.

X3DGeometryNode.defn: Geometry nodes produce renderable geometry and are contained by a Shape node.

X3DGroupingNode.defn: Grouping nodes can contain other nodes as children, thus making up the backbone of a scene graph.

X3DInfoNode.defn: Base type for all nodes that contain only information without visual semantics.

X3DInterpolatorNode.defn: Interpolator nodes are designed for linear keyframed animation. Interpolators are driven by an input key ranging [0..1] and produce corresponding piecewise-linear output functions.

X3DKeyDeviceSensorNode.defn: Base type for all sensor node types that operate using key devices.

X3DLayerNode.defn: The X3DLayerNode abstract node type is the base node type for layer nodes.

X3DLayoutNode.defn: X3DLayoutNode is the base node type for layout nodes.

X3DLightNode.defn: Light nodes provide illumination for rendering geometry in the scene. Implementing nodes must include a global field with type SFBool and accessType inputOutput.

X3DMaterialNode.defn: Base type for all Material nodes.

X3DMetadataObject.defn: Each node inheriting the X3DMetadataObject interface contains a single array of strictly typed values: MFBool, MFInt32, MFFloat, MFDouble, MFString, or MFNode, the latter having children that are all

X3DNBodyCollidableNode.defn: The X3DNBodyCollidableNode abstract node type represents objects that act as the interface between the rigid body physics, collision geometry proxy, and renderable objects in the scene graph hierarchy

X3DNBodyCollisionSpaceNode.defn: The X3DNBodyCollisionSpaceNode abstract node type represents objects that act as a self-contained spatial collection of objects that can interact through collision detection routines.

X3DNetworkSensorNode.defn: Base typefor all sensors that generate events based on network activity.

X3DNode.defn: All instantiable nodes implement X3DNode, which corresponds to SFNode type in the X3D specification.

X3DNormalNode.defn: Base type for all normal node types in X3D.

X3DNurbsControlCurveNode.defn: Base type for all nodes that provide control curve information in 2D space.

X3DNurbsSurfaceGeometryNode.defn: Abstract geometry type for all types of NURBS surfaces.

X3DOneSidedMaterialNode.defn: Base type for material nodes that describe how the shape looks like from one side. A different number of contanied texture nodes are allowed by each of the implementing nodes.

X3DParametricGeometryNode.defn: Base type for all geometry node types that are created parametrically and use control points to describe the final shape of the surface.

X3DParticleEmitterNode.defn: The X3DParticleEmitterNode abstract type represents any node that is an emitter of particles.

X3DParticlePhysicsModelNode.defn: The X3DParticlePhysicsModelNode abstract type represents any node that applies a form of constraints on the particles after they have been generated.

X3DPickSensorNode.defn: The X3DPickSensorNode abstract node type is the base node type that represents the lowest common denominator of picking capabilities.

X3DPickableObject.defn: The X3DPickableObject abstract interface marks a node as being capable of having customized picking performed on its contents or children.

X3DPointingDeviceSensorNode.defn: Base type for all pointing device sensors.

X3DProductStructureChildNode.defn: Base type marking nodes that are valid product structure children for the CADGeometry component.

X3DProgrammableShaderObject.defn: Base type for all nodes that specify arbitrary fields for interfacing with per-object attribute values.

X3DPrototypeInstance.defn: Base type for all prototype instances. Note that direct children nodes are disallowed, instead let fieldValue with type SFNode/MFNode contain them. Current practice is that, if desired, prototype auth

X3DRigidJointNode.defn: The X3DRigidJointNode abstract node type is the base type for all joint types.

X3DScriptNode.defn: Base type for scripting nodes (but not shader nodes).

X3DSequencerNode.defn: Base type from which all Sequencers are derived.

X3DShaderNode.defn: Base type for all nodes that specify a programmable shader.

X3DShapeNode.defn: Base type for all Shape nodes.

X3DSingleTextureCoordinateNode.defn: Base type for all texture coordinate nodes which specify texture coordinates for a single texture.

X3DSingleTextureNode.defn: Base type for all texture node types that define a single texture. A single texture can be used to influence a parameter of various material nodes in the Shape component, and it can be a child of Mult

X3DSingleTextureTransformNode.defn: Base type for all texture transform nodes which specify texture coordinate transformation for a single texture.

X3DSoundChannelNode.defn: Base type for all sound destination nodes, which represent the final destination of an audio signal and are what the user can ultimately hear.

X3DSoundDestinationNode.defn: Base type for all sound destination nodes, which represent the final destination of an audio signal and are what the user can ultimately hear.

X3DSoundNode.defn: Base type for all sound nodes.

X3DSoundProcessingNode.defn: Base type for all sound processing nodes, which are used to enhance audio with filtering, delaying, changing gain, etc.

X3DSoundSourceNode.defn: Nodes implementing X3DSoundSourceNode provide signal inputs to the audio graph.

X3DStatement.defn: X3DStatement is a marker interface that identifies statements relating to nonrenderable scene graph structure. X3DStatement does not extend from any other node type since it is not an explicit part of

X3DTangentNode.defn: Base type for all tangent node types in X3D.

X3DTexture2DNode.defn: Base type for all nodes which specify 2D sources for texture images.

X3DTexture3DNode.defn: Base type for all nodes that specify 3D sources for texture images.

X3DTextureCoordinateNode.defn: Base type for all nodes which specify texture coordinates.

X3DTextureNode.defn: Base type for all nodes which specify sources for texture images.

X3DTextureProjectorNode.defn: Base type for all node types that specify texture projector nodes, which provide a form of lighting.

X3DTextureTransformNode.defn: Base type for all nodes which specify a transformation of texture coordinates.

X3DTimeDependentNode.defn: Base type from which all time-dependent nodes are derived.

X3DTouchSensorNode.defn: Base type for all touch-style pointing device sensors.

X3DTriggerNode.defn: Base type from which all trigger nodes are derived.

X3DUrlObject.defn: X3DUrlObject indicates that a node has content loaded from a Uniform Resource Locator (URL) and can be tracked via a LoadSensor. Such child nodes have containerField='children' to indicate their relat

X3DUrlOutputObject.defn: X3DUrlOutputObject indicates that a node publish data on the local file system or to a network address.

X3DVertexAttributeNode.defn: Base type for all nodes that specify per-vertex attribute information to the shader.

X3DViewpointNode.defn: Node type X3DViewpointNode defines a specific location in the local coordinate system from which the user may view the scene, and also defines a viewpoint binding stack.

X3DViewportNode.defn: The X3DViewportNode abstract node type is the base node type for viewport nodes.

X3DVolumeDataNode.defn: The X3DVolumeDataNode abstract node type is the base type for all node types that describe volumetric data to be rendered.

X3DVolumeRenderStyleNode.defn: The X3DVolumeRenderStyleNode abstract node type is the base type for all node types that specify a specific visual rendering style to be used when rendering volume data.

component.defn: Functional summary: each added component statement indicates needed scene functionality support above the given X3D profile.

connect.defn: Functional summary: connect statements define event-routing connections between node fields defined inside a ProtoBody declaration back to corresponding ProtoInterface fields.

field.defn: Functional summary: a field statement defines an interface attribute or node. Each field statement can contain either attribute-value or node content.

fieldValue.defn: Functional summary: a fieldValue statement re-initializes the default value of a field in a ProtoInstance. Each fieldValue statement can contain either attribute-value or node content.

head.defn: Functional summary: each X3D scene includes a head statement that can contain component, unit and meta statements.

meta.defn: Functional summary: the meta statement provides metadata information about a scene, where name and content attributes provide attribute=value metadata pairs.

unit.defn: Functional summary: unit statement defines data-conversion factors for typed values defined in a scene.
